title: City Transport Manager
notes:
New: Your map can now grow much further! Large games need far less memory and run much more smoothly on less powerful devices.
There is also a dark map: choose Light, Dark or Match device in the game menu. For every line you can now choose "Both ways" or "One way" and reverse its direction with a tap. Lines of the same color share one lane, you can rename your company, and cloud saves sync more reliably between your devices. Plus fewer crashes and many bug fixes. Thank you for your feedback!
